faq.heading: Have questions? Here are some answers for you

items.q: How long does a solar installation usually take?
items.a: Most residential solar installations are completed within 1–3 days, depending on system size.

items.q: Do solar panels work on cloudy days?
items.a: Yes, solar panels generate electricity on cloudy days too, albeit at reduced efficiency. They can capture diffuse sunlight and continue producing energy even when the sun isn't shining directly.

items.q: What maintenance do solar systems need?
items.a: Solar systems require minimal maintenance. Usually it is enough to clean the modules 2–4 times a year and have a professional annual inspection carried out to operate the system optimally.

items.q: What is a grid-tied solar solution?
items.a: A grid-tied solar system is connected to the power grid and allows you to draw electricity when needed and sell excess energy back to the grid through net-metering programs.
